name: Bhavadeva
role: Deva ruler linked to southeastern Bengal
contribution: A ruler associated with the Deva dynasty and the Mainamati-Lalmai regional context.
context: He represents the regional political formations that shaped southeastern Bengal after and alongside larger imperial traditions.
impact: His inclusion strengthens coverage of pre-sultanate eastern Bengal and its Buddhist-archaeological landscape.
highlight: His inclusion strengthens coverage of pre-sultanate eastern Bengal and its Buddhist-archaeological landscape.
